summary.en: The pile a stream film opens on: three session windows, four alerts, a sticky note with two questions and fourteen dialog copies cascading, on a daytime desktop or as dark cards over the night; states empty, piled and pierced (every item lit where the thread passes).
summary.zh: stream 片开场的那堆东西：三个会话窗口、四个弹窗、一张写着两个问题的便签、十四个层叠的对话框副本，铺在白天的桌面上或作为暗色卡片散在夜空里；状态有空、堆满、被线穿过（每件被穿过处亮起）。

fits: The problem of a product that takes work off people: too many windows, approvals and questions at once.
notFor: A pile that must be read item by item; a calm opening; a product that is not about handing work off.

intent.en: Show "too much at once" as texture before the product takes it all.
intent.zh: 在产品接手之前，先把“同时太多”做成一片质感给人看。

content.en: Three sessions (title, ask, status), four alerts (title, yes, no), a two-line note; the copies repeat the sessions; optional: 1–6 alerts and 4–30 dialog copies.
content.zh: 三个会话（标题、请求、状态）、四个弹窗（标题、是、否）、两行便签；副本重复这些会话；可选：1–6 条通知、4–30 个弹窗副本。

fits.zh: 帮人接活的产品要讲的问题：同时太多窗口、审批和问题。

notFor.zh: 要一条条读的堆；安静的开场；和“把事交出去”无关的产品。

pairs.note: the thread runs through every item

en: Only the note and the freeze line are read; the windows and alerts are texture, so their copy may be short and generic.
The 14 copies cascade from the approval window: keep that window's ask short or the cascade covers the note.
zh: 只有便签和定格那句要读；窗口和弹窗是质感，文案可以短而泛。
14 个副本从那个待审批窗口层叠出来：它的请求要短，否则层叠会盖住便签。
